import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Parse ICS file and extract events
def parse_ics(filename):
    events = []
    with open(filename, 'r') as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    # Extract VEVENT blocks
    event_pattern = re.compile(r'BEGIN:VEVENT(.*?)END:VEVENT', re.DOTALL)
    for match in event_pattern.finditer(content):
        event_block = match.group(1)
        
        # Extract DTSTART and DTEND
        dtstart_match = re.search(r'DTSTART:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)', event_block)
        dtend_match = re.search(r'DTEND:(\d{8}T\d{6}Z)', event_block)
        
        if dtstart_match and dtend_match:
            dtstart_str = dtstart_match.group(1)
            dtend_str = dtend_match.group(1)
            
            dtstart = datetime.strptime(dtstart_str, '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
            dtend = datetime.strptime(dtend_str, '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
            
            events.append({'start': dtstart, 'end': dtend})
    
    return events

# Parse all calendars
alice_events = parse_ics('/app/alice_calendar.ics')
bob_events = parse_ics('/app/bob_calendar.ics')
carol_events = parse_ics('/app/carol_calendar.ics')

    return False
